cookbooks.title: Getting Started with LangBot + Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Start Valkey, verify the connection, and wire LangBot's opt-in Valkey backends for rate limiting and vector search.

cookbooks.title: Distributed Rate Limiting with Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Share a single fixed-window rate-limit counter across LangBot workers with an atomic INCR + EXPIRE Lua script and a fail-open posture.

cookbooks.title: Vector Search for the Knowledge Base
cookbooks.h1: Vector Search for the Knowledge Base
cookbooks.lead: Use Valkey Search as a RAG vector backend — create an HNSW index, store embeddings as HASH keys, and run KNN similarity queries with valkey-glide's typed ft API.

cookbooks.title: Hybrid Search & Metadata Filtering
cookbooks.lead: Combine full-text and vector search with filter-then-KNN, scope results by file_id TAG filters, and understand the vector_weight caveat and query-injection safety.
